materials.construction: An isotropic all-over field of distinct tiny FLAT ANGULAR gravel chips embedded flush in sand. Chips are approximately 1 to 2 percent of image width, each a simple irregular solid shape, short angular ends, muted gray-brown. Distribute individual chips uniformly with modest local random pairs and trios; 30 percent coverage. Neighboring gaps are only a few chip widths. No patch or density grouping larger than 8 percent of image width. Every quarter has the same average density. Random orientations with no preferential angle. Never broad connected clusters, bands, swirls, diagonal corridors, islands, crack cells, contour lines, ridges or waves. Flat print-like albedo only; no raised edges or lighting. At 128px the defining cue is crisp angular chip grain scattered across plain sand.

materials.construction: An isotropic matte field of FLAT tightly compacted dusty soil. Predominantly continuous smooth dark tan fill. Small disconnected soft scuff patches of rubbed powder, each about 3 to 7 percent of width, with only sparse fine gritty short specks at their ends. Random orientation and placement; each patch isolated, with no connected boundaries. Even overall density in every quarter. Short diffuse scuffs are softly elongated blobs, never large sweeping strokes. No patch or feature longer than 8 percent of width. No plates, ridges, shallow depressions, bright/dark edge pairs, broad lobes, diagonal formations, waves, dunes, wavy bands, crack/cell network, tracks or repeated stamp. Compaction reads as locally smooth rubbed flat areas with sparse gritty flecks, unlike angular gravel chips and unlike entirely soft fine-silt veils.
